DNB NYC publishes dnbnycradio@gmail.com and explicitly features local and international artists. House in Harlem publishes tinad903@gmail.com and features DJs from around the world. Mystic Vybes publishes mysticvybes@gmail.com. These addresses are first-party published and syntactically valid but use consumer Gmail domains, so domain alignment cannot be established. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed. No email or physical item was sent.
